summary: Inspected LeanBridge/ForMathlib/QExpansion/DeltaBridge.lean (6063 bytes). This file contains substantial formal mathematical content: definitions of modular forms (E₄CubeSubE₆SqForm', deltaForm), lemmas proving their properties and equivalence to mathlib's discriminant (deltaForm_eq_discriminant), q-expansion theorems (qExpansion_deltaForm, discriminant_qExpansion_eq), the main bridge theorem connecting list-based Delta_qexpList coefficients to the formal q-expansion of the discriminant (discriminant_qExpansion_coeff_eq_Delta_qexpList), concrete sanity-check examples computing tau(5)=4830 and tau(6)=-6048, and a generic framework re-derivation using evalEisPS. This is core mathematical content, not tactic/command implementation.
